title: Match event
description: One synthetic match event. Matches are stored as JSON lines, one event per line, sorted by t. Pitch is 105 by 68 metres; x runs from the home goal line (0) to the away goal line (105) in both halves, and y from the near touchline (0) to the far touchline (68).

t.description: Seconds of play elapsed since kickoff, ignoring half time. Always increases, so it drives the replay.

clock.description: Match clock in seconds as a broadcast shows it: the second half starts at 2700, so 4032 shows as 67:12.

team.description: Club code of the team that performs the event.

recipient.description: Intended receiver of a pass, or the player coming on in a substitution.

subtype.description: Detail for set pieces, the line the ball went out over, and kinds of pass.

pressure.description: How closely the player on the ball is being closed down.

speed_mps.description: Metres per second: ball speed for passes and shots, the player's running speed for carries.
